title: prunella alba var. hispida
intro: Prunella alba var. hispida, commonly known as White Selfheal, is a variety of the Prunella alba plant, a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, due to its antibacterial and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Prunella alba var. hispida include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as thymol and carvacrol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
